prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Original high-fidelity Chinese Northern and Southern Dynasties strategy RPG interface concept for 风云南北朝. Render a landscape 1536x1024 image. Cohesive hand-painted Chinese ink and light color art, charcoal brush-edged window, thin antique-gold rules, warm fibrous ivory paper, muted ink-green, tiny cinnabar seals. Flat implementable UI, NOT a physical desk or SaaS dashboard. No ornate fantasy frame, bevels, giant logo, KPI tiles, charts, glowing neon or rounded web cards. Portraits are small Chinese sixth-century flat line-and-wash, architecture timber and tiled roofs. Compact title, modest illustration dissolved into ink, clear Chinese text. Body typography visually 14-16px at 1536 wide, headings 20-24px, controls compact not oversized. Close is a small simple X in upper-right, old gold on dark ink with no diamond frame; tabs ONE horizontal row of small pictogram plus two-character title, selected with pale brush paper. Bottom single secondary return/cancel and single gold primary only when action exists. Keep map visible around windows. Text and data are illustrative: small readable footer '设计预览 · 非实机 · 数值示意'.Create a 2x2 concept board of four separate dialogs, each complete and readable, simple uniform gutters, identical restrained charcoal brush frame and single small gold X when closable. TOP LEFT '商约交割': painted cart and warehouse mini-vignettes, compact source and destination strip. Footer 取消 / 确认处置. BOTTOM LEFT '差事案卷': small responsible official portraits on compact header, one thin actual-status timeline 受理 拟案 办理 结案 with single current marker, text 当前待批复.
